info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Create Insurance Claims Claims Submit-v2-spec
info.description: The Insurance Claims Submission API enables users to efficiently submit new insurance claims for processing. It streamlines the claims submission process, allowing insurance agents and policyholders to input relevant claim details directly into the system. This API facilitates accurate data capture and initiates the workflow for claim assessment. Typical consumers include insurance companies, claims adjusters, and applications integrated into customer service platforms for seamless operations.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit a claim, providing all necessary details to ensure correct processing. Ensure that all required fields are filled out to avoid processing delays.

requestBody.description: Request body for submitting a claims operation. This must include all necessary information as defined by the application schema to process the claims submission effectively.

200.description: The claim was successfully submitted and processed.
